params.name: formula
params.description: Formula (expression) object assigned as the object's data source; pass Null to reset to a dynamic form variable.

overloads.semanticRole: Assigns a 4D.Formula as the dynamic data source of the designated form object, evaluated at runtime.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

constraints: Passing Null as formula resets the object's data source to a dynamic form variable.
Does nothing if applied to an object that does not exist or cannot support formulas.
The formula executes in the context of the form that owns the object; ensure formulas used in subforms are defined/assigned in the correct form context.
If assigning a formula to an input object or another object with a modifiable value, the formula must be assignable.
